title: 78 ##### 4.3.2. Disposal of persons arrested under the local & special laws A total of 42,62,464 persons were under trial during 1981, including those under trial carried over from the previous year. 35.2 per cent of the total undertrials in custody remained in custody pending completion of trials at the end of the year, while 84.7 per cent of the total persons, in whose cases trials were completed, were convicted during the year. The percentage of conviction to total persons whose trials were completed was consistently high, and for most of the offences it was above 70.0 per cent, except for offences under the 'Prevention of Corruption Act', 'Prohibition Act', 'Explosives and Explosive Substances Act', 'Customs Act' and 'Arms Act' in which the convictions recorded were 59.0 per cent, 48.5 per cent, 52.2 per cent, 59.0 per cent and 69.9 per cent respectively. The relevant statistics may be seen in Table-29.
